verdict.rationale: Token2 ships an official open-source CLI, fido2-manage, built on libfido2. It handles PIN set/change and minimum PIN length, resident credential and bio-template management, and device info dumps to JSON/CSV, which supports scripting. However, it is scoped to FIDO2 only. PIV/OTP configuration is handled by the GUI Companion App or the Windows miniDriver, not the CLI. missing for 10: CLI enabling/disabling of applications or interfaces, PIV/OTP slot management from the CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of scripted use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure and manage the key from an official CLI — enable applications, set PINs, manage slots, read device state — scriptably

citations.quote: Open-source FIDO2 management utility based on `libfido2`, providing command-line tools and an optional graphical interface for advanced key management operations.
PIN management: set, change, set minimum PIN length, min-PIN-length RP allow-list
Audit/export: dump device info + relying parties to JSON or CSV
Resident credentials (passkeys): list (with user handle), delete, edit metadata
